lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The central three rows exhibit the highest pixel intensity and most regular longitudinal spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Seven visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal blob rows at near-90 degree angles, forming a coordinate grid where the primary blobs act as nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible mid-flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral), extending from the posterior gill margin toward the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-resolution high-luminance blobs visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher concentration toward the base of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Pectoral fin displays a dense, stochastic distribution of high-luminance spots on its leading edge, transitioning to a more structured, grid-aligned pattern toward the posterior margin.
